semantic_validation: Use strict JSON parsing and finite binary64 coordinates. Reject duplicate keys, duplicate atom IDs, unsupported fields and incompatible model inputs explicitly.

Derive atomic numbers, nuclear masses and electron count from the species, isotope and charge. For H-1 pairs check the candidate distance interval in SI; the interval is a proposed model restriction, not a measured capacity.

Keep authored coordinates and atom order immutable. The engine mapping must record the finite-cell transform and atom IDs; reject positions or density extent outside the admitted model and cell conditions. The transform, finite-cell admission and field mapping remain pending.
Resolve the named model and numerical settings explicitly before execution. Reject unsupported settings and platforms; do not fall back to another method, precision, asset, image or geometry.
Hash the authored revision, execution plan and resolved scientific state separately using RFC 8785. Raw engine inputs, logs, field files, engine images and basis assets retain exact byte identities.

model.reference_energy: electronic energy plus nuclear repulsion, excluding rest, zero-point and thermal terms
model.forces: negative Cartesian gradient of the total energy at fixed model and numerical settings

candidate_platform.x86_64_scope: Source-traced x86-64-v2 candidate passed isolated A03 and pinned upstream GAPW. The original revision-unknown x86 image remains a historical A03 control.

basis_and_potential.target_basis: unselected; the provisional cc-pVTZ target did not pass the G2 pilot comparisons

units.arithmetic: IEEE 754 binary64, roundTiesToEven; use the pinned multiplier for each engine output
units.nuclear_mass_engine_input_rule: Divide the decimal bare mass in kg by CP2K 2006 decimal atomic mass unit 1.660538782e-27 kg at 40 significant decimal digits, round half even; CP2K parses the emitted MASS in engine u to binary64.

cube.integral_rule: compensated sum of signed serialized samples times abs(det(serialized step vectors in bohr))

fixed_fixture_basis_screen.scope: H2 at 0.60 angstrom and He; six converged CP2K calculations, both mandatory TZ-QZ comparisons failed

fixed_fixture_qz_sensitivity.scope: H2 at 0.60 angstrom and He; 16 converged calculations and 10 of 12 comparisons passed. Both CUTOFF comparisons failed the original density shape screen.

fixed_fixture_scf_screen.remaining: Atom-centered grid, basis and selected joint settings, followed by independent acceptance.

proposal_unexecuted.grid_policy: Vary one family at a time with others fixed at checked fine settings; compare the finest two by AV03 and AV04, then cross-check selected joint settings. Review limits before executing larger grids.
proposal_unexecuted.cube_policy: Check AV06 on each of the two finest export grids and record their difference and negative-sample diagnostics. A matching electron count does not establish spatial field-shape convergence.

freeze_gates_pending: Lock one execution profile, admissible geometry and finite-cell transform, and the supported basis and numerical limits before acceptance tests.
Recheck resource admission for the proposed refinement runs; the A03 resource envelope only covers the measured cases.
Review the draft input and validation criteria together before assigning a runtime contract version.
